scenario.name: r-cd-silent
scenario.description: Typed continue_delegate(mode='silent') proof. Fires a silent delegate, waits for child internal completion, then asks the parent to report the silent child token from internal context while checking no child channel delivery occurred.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the dispatching sessions.send turn that asks the agent to call continue_delegate(mode=silent).

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-scheduled-sentinel
expectedReceipts.description: Parent emitted RCDS-SCHEDULED only after continue_delegate returned a scheduled result.

expectedReceipts.name: child-completion-observed
expectedReceipts.description: The silent delegate child completed on the internal subagent stream before the follow-up turn was sent.

expectedReceipts.name: followup-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: A later follow-up turn was accepted after the silent delegate had time to return.

expectedReceipts.name: parent-internal-context-observed
expectedReceipts.description: Parent follow-up reported the child-only SILENTCHILD token that was not included in the follow-up prompt.

expectedReceipts.name: no-channel-delivery
expectedReceipts.description: No channel-delivery event contained the child-only silent delegate token.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from dispatch response or task metadata for Tempo fetch/review.

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the continue_delegate tool → continuation.delegate.dispatch → continuation.delegate.fire topology, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace matched by the row’s reason hash, length, and delegate mode, holding one continuation.delegate.dispatch span, one continuation.delegate.fire span, and the originating continue_delegate tool span on one trace and chain.

review.notes: PASS-candidate requires child internal completion, delayed child-token readback from parent internal context, and no child-token channel delivery. Prefer disposable sessions for repeated runs.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_delegate tool span to continuation.delegate.dispatch and continuation.delegate.fire only by shared trace, causal timing, and the reason fingerprint and mode. This manifest has no invocation.promptTemplate and the scenario publishes no reason fingerprint, so collect-continuation-trace.mjs refuses to attribute the trace and the trace receipts stay pending until the row records its task fingerprint.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_delegate evidence. Joined to the dispatch span only by shared trace and causal timing.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Delegate task material is published only as a digest, a length and the delegate mode, inside a public-safe Tempo projection. Task text, prompt bodies, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The silent delegate is scheduled, its child completes on the internal stream, and a later follow-up turn reports the child-only SILENTCHILD token from internal context.
controls.negative: The child-only token must never appear in a channel-delivery event, and a harness prompt echo cannot satisfy the readback.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: Child internal completion, delayed child-token readback from parent internal context, and no child-token channel delivery. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Any of those receipts is missing. Missing or unattributable traces keep the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: Not emitted by this scenario: an incomplete run is PARTIAL-candidate. Neither trace receipt can produce or clear a FAIL.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-silent.js fires continue_delegate(mode=silent) and the follow-up readback turn.
execution.manual: Until the row publishes its task fingerprint, a reviewer must locate and attach the trace by hand.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live silent delegate row. Uses a child-only token plus follow-up readback to prove internal parent context without treating prompt echo as success. Serialize per target session.
